_comment: Tier-2 for febio::fluid#0. <Module type="solid"/> with <solver type="fluid"> gives 'tag "solver" (line N) : invalid value for attribute "type"' and 'Reading file ...FAILED!' — the solver factory is module-scoped and is checked before <Material> is read, which the fixture pins by asserting the material name never appears in the output. Positive control: the shipped template, unmodified, which reaches normal termination — so the message is attributable to the single thing that was changed. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
